best_for: Video editors wanting to add motion graphics to their repertoire
Content creators needing dynamic VFX and titles
not_for: Those who only want to cut live-action footage
target_audience.who_should_take_foundation_first: Individuals with no Adobe ecosystem experience should take Photoshop/Illustrator or Premiere Pro first.

prerequisites.required: Basic understanding of layers and design principles.
prerequisites.recommended: Prior experience with Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator.

system_requirements.hardware: Multi-core processor, 32GB RAM recommended (16GB minimum), Dedicated GPU.
system_requirements.software_accounts: Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, Premiere Pro.

overview.positioning: A deep dive into the industry-standard software for motion graphics and visual effects.
overview.short_description: Master keyframing, compositing, kinetic typography, and motion tracking in Adobe After Effects.
what_you_will_be_able_to_do: Use the graph editor for smooth, organic motion
Composite green screen footage and track motion

why_now.industry_shift: Static graphics are dying. Every major social platform prioritizes video and animated content.
why_now.ai_impact: AI tools in AE (like Roto Brush 2) eliminate tedious masking, letting animators focus purely on motion and design.
why_now.business_demand: High demand for 'preditors' (producer-editors) who can both cut video and create custom motion graphics.
why_now.career_opportunity: Adding After Effects to your skill set significantly increases your hourly rate and employability.

learning_outcomes: ANIMATE: Master keyframes, easing, and the graph editor.
DESIGN: Create kinetic typography and shape layer animations.
COMPOSITE: Use track mattes, masks, and blending modes.
TRACK: Perform 2D motion tracking and screen replacements.

stages.focus: Combining assets into a final explainer video.

core_tools.what_student_builds: Logo animations, UI animations, explainer videos.

stages.name: Import & Setup
stages.desc: Importing as a composition and organizing the timeline.

stages.name: Animation
stages.desc: Setting keyframes and adjusting the graph editor.

ai_integration.ai_can_assist_with: Isolating subjects (Roto Brush), removing objects (Content-Aware Fill).
ai_integration.ai_cannot_replace: The 12 principles of animation and visual rhythm.
ai_integration.human_expertise_required: Graph editor adjustments and design aesthetics.

best_practices: Pre-compose complex layer stacks to keep the timeline clean.

common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Not knowing how to use the graph editor.
common_mistakes.professional_approach: Always adjust speed graphs for organic motion.

career_paths.what_student_demonstrates: A short showreel of varied AE projects.

freelance_applications.portfolio_requirements: A Vimeo portfolio with 3-5 high-quality examples.

final_deliverables: A 30-second explainer video with sound design.

assessment.criteria: Smoothness of motion (easing), design composition, and technical execution.

not_covered: Complex 3D character rigging or Cinema 4D integration (covered in Motion Graphics Master).

faq.question: Is After Effects hard to learn?
faq.answer: It has a steep learning curve due to the interface, but focusing on core concepts like keyframing and masking makes it manageable.

modules.module_purpose: Understand the AE interface and master the art of smooth animation.
what_you_will_learn: Transform properties (Anchor Point, Position, Scale, Rotation, Opacity)

lessons.what_is_taught: Navigating the UI and animating basic properties.
lessons.why_it_matters: The absolute foundation of all motion graphics.
lessons.expected_outcome: Understanding of the timeline and keyframes.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using the speed graph to create ease-in, ease-out, and custom velocity curves.
lessons.why_it_matters: Separates amateur, robotic motion from professional, organic motion.
lessons.what_learner_does: Refines the bouncing ball and animates UI elements with custom easing.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using alpha track mattes for text reveals and pre-composing layers.
lessons.why_it_matters: Essential for clean transitions and organizing complex timelines.

modules.module_purpose: Build dynamic, vector-based animations for explainer videos and ads.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Trim Paths, Repeater, and Wiggle Paths.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows for complex vector animations without manual keyframing.
lessons.what_learner_does: Animates bursting lines and abstract shapes.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using text animators and range selectors to automate text motion.
lessons.why_it_matters: Crucial for social media ads and lyric videos.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using null objects to control multiple layers and the wiggle expression.
lessons.what_learner_does: Rigs a simple mechanical arm or camera move.

modules.hands_on_practice: Build a kinetic typography scene synced to an audio clip.
modules.expected_outcome: Ability to create engaging text and vector motion.

modules.module_purpose: Integrate graphics into live-action footage and complete the final project.

lessons.what_is_taught: Point tracking and planar tracking with Mocha for screen replacements.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows graphics to lock seamlessly into moving footage.
lessons.what_learner_does: Replaces the screen of a moving smartphone with custom UI.

lessons.what_is_taught: Using Roto Brush to isolate subjects from their backgrounds.
lessons.why_it_matters: Allows placing text or graphics *behind* moving people in video.
lessons.what_learner_does: Places large kinetic text behind a walking subject.

lessons.what_is_taught: Bringing together shape layers, text, and tracking into a final project.
lessons.why_it_matters: Proves end-to-end competency in After Effects.
lessons.what_learner_does: Builds, refines, and exports a 30-second explainer video.

modules.hands_on_practice: Complete a screen replacement and rotoscope shot, then finalize the capstone.
